B: Chelation of copper by disulfiram metabolite diethyldithiocarbamate suppresses NPL4-UFD1-VCP-mediated protein degradation, leading to unresolved ER stress in AML stem cells.
C: Selective apoptosis of CD34+CD38- AML stem cells while sparing normal hematopoietic stem cells.
statement: Disulfiram, an anti-alcoholism drug, eradicates quiescent AML stem cells via copper-dependent NPL4 inhibition without myelotoxicity.

B: Inhibition of thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) causes lethal accumulation of reactive oxygen species specifically in AML cells with hyperactive oxidative phosphorylation.
C: Collapse of mitochondrial membrane potential and ferroptotic death in AML blasts, including venetoclax-resistant MCL1-dependent clones.
statement: Auranofin, an oral anti-rheumatic gold compound, sensitizes high-ROS AML cells to ferroptosis by disabling the thioredoxin antioxidant barrier.

B: Dopamine receptor D2 (DRD2) antagonism on AML cells disrupts STAT5 phosphorylation and downstream c-Myc translation via a non-canonical dopamine-cAMP-PKA pathway.
C: Impaired self-renewal of leukemic stem cells and reduced bone marrow engraftment in NPM1-mutated AML.
statement: Prochlorperazine, a DRD2 antagonist approved for vertigo, blocks STAT5-driven stemness programs in NPM1c+ AML through a dopamine receptor-mediated mechanism.

B: Inhibition of TGF-β1-mediated SMAD2/3 phosphorylation in bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells reverses leukemic niche-mediated quiescence of AML stem cells.
C: Cell-cycle re-entry of dormant AML stem cells, sensitizing them to cytarabine and reducing minimal residual disease.
statement: Pirfenidone, an antifibrotic agent, overcomes stroma-induced chemoresistance by normalizing TGF-β signaling in the AML niche, forcing leukemic stem cells out of dormancy.

B: Inhibition of Hedgehog pathway activator Smoothened (SMO) and concurrent suppression of mitochondrial cholesterol trafficking via NPC1 blockade in AML cells results in dual GLI1 depletion and oxysterol-mediated LXR activation.
C: Terminal myeloid differentiation and apoptosis of FLT3-ITD AML blasts, independent of FLT3 mutation status.
statement: Itraconazole, a triazole antifungal, differentiates AML blasts by simultaneously blocking SMO and NPC1, synergistically depleting GLI1 and activating LXR-mediated pro-differentiation transcripts.

B: Tubulin depolymerization at low concentrations selectively reduces cell-surface integrin α5β1 trafficking in AML cells, blocking fibronectin-mediated adhesion and VLA-4-dependent homing.
C: Prevention of leukemic cell engraftment in the bone marrow niche and mobilization of AML blasts into peripheral blood.
statement: Mebendazole, an anthelmintic, reduces AML bone marrow retention by disrupting integrin α5β1 surface expression through microtubule-dependent vesicular transport inhibition.

B: Lysosomal accumulation of clofazimine in AML cells triggers lysosomal membrane permeabilization and release of cathepsin B, activating the NLRP3 inflammasome and pyroptosis specifically in monocytes/macrophage-like AML.
C: Pyroptotic clearance of AML blasts and modulation of immune microenvironment via IL-1β release and dendritic cell maturation.
statement: Clofazimine, an antileprosy drug, induces immunogenic pyroptosis in monocytic AML subtypes through lysosomal destabilization and inflammasome activation.

B: Squalene epoxidase inhibition by terbinafine causes squalene accumulation, leading to a specific disruption of lipid raft architecture and impaired internalization of FLT3 receptor in AML cells.
C: Sustained FLT3 surface expression leading to enhanced degradation-independent downregulation of FLT3 signaling and selective apoptosis in FLT3-ITD AML.
statement: Terbinafine, an antifungal, suppresses FLT3-ITD signaling via altering lipid raft composition, locking FLT3 on the plasma membrane in a signaling-inactive conformation.

B: Inhibition of xCT (SLC7A11) by sulfasalazine blocks cystine import, depleting glutathione specifically in AML cells with mutant IDH1/2, which already exhibit NADPH depletion from 2-hydroxyglutarate production.
C: Massive lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis in IDH-mutant AML cells under normoxic conditions.
statement: Sulfasalazine, an anti-inflammatory, induces synthetic lethality with IDH mutations in AML by exacerbating glutathione depletion and ferroptosis.

B: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) inhibition by tolcapone increases the concentration of endogenous catechol metabolites that directly alkylate and inactivate mutant LDHA in AML cells reliant on aerobic glycolysis.
C: Metabolic collapse from NAD+ regeneration failure and ATP depletion, selectively killing AML cells with high glycolytic flux.
statement: Tolcapone, a COMT inhibitor for Parkinson's, disrupts glycolysis in AML via toxic catechol accumulation that inactivates mutant LDHA.

B: Dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH) inhibition by leflunomide’s active metabolite teriflunomide blocks de novo pyrimidine synthesis, reducing the intracellular UTP pool and consequently inhibiting P2Y purinergic receptor-driven calcium oscillations in AML blasts.
C: Reversal of P2Y-linked chemoresistance and induction of differentiation in NPM1-mutant AML under low-cytosine conditions.
statement: Leflunomide, an immunosuppressive, overrides differentiation block in NPM1-mutant AML by reducing pyrimidine-driven P2Y receptor signaling.

B: Alpha-1 adrenergic receptor blockade on AML blasts paradoxically activates the STING pathway via mitochondrial DNA release due to disruption of mitochondrial quality control mediated by α1-AR-AMPK axis.
C: Induction of type I interferon response and immunogenic cell death, promoting CD8+ T cell-mediated clearance of AML.
statement: Prazosin, an antihypertensive, turns AML cells immunologically hot by triggering STING-dependent interferon production through mitochondrial stress caused by α1-AR inhibition.

B: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibition by escitalopram increases extracellular serotonin in bone marrow, activating 5-HT2B receptor on AML cells, which triggers PLCβ-Ca2+-NFAT-mediated expression of pro-apoptotic factor BIM.
C: Selective apoptosis of AML blasts overexpressing 5-HT2B receptor, particularly in MLL-rearranged infant AML.
statement: Escitalopram, an SSRI antidepressant, drives BIM-dependent apoptosis in AML via boosting serotonin-mediated 5-HT2B receptor signaling.

B: Angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) blockade by candesartan abrogates angiotensin II-induced secretion of IL-6 and CCL2 from AML-associated bone marrow adipocytes, interrupting paracrine support for AML stem cell quiescence.
C: Loss of niche protection, leading to depletion of CD36+ AML stem cells co-localized with adipocytes.
statement: Candesartan, an ARB antihypertensive, eradicates CD36+ AML stem cells by breaking AT1R-mediated crosstalk with bone marrow adipocytes.

B: L-type calcium channel blockade by verapamil at sub-cardiotropic doses specifically inhibits the calcium-dependent protease calpain-2 in FLT3-ITD AML, preventing cleavage of the pro-apoptotic protein BID into mtBID.
C: Accumulation of full-length BID with unexpected pro-apoptotic gain-of-function, sensitizing AML cells to TRAIL-induced apoptosis.
statement: Verapamil, a calcium channel blocker, sensitizes FLT3-ITD AML to TRAIL by blocking calpain-mediated BID cleavage, paradoxically promoting the activity of full-length BID.
